bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 97,000 views on one reel. The top price is £9.99.
beats.text: Your Vanguard ETF reel passed 97,000 views, you've posted 388 YouTube videos in 16 months, and before this you taught 25,000+ people through Learning:Crypto. But the most anyone can pay you today is £9.99 a month for Plus.

beats.title: “Comment Screener” already works.
beats.text: One “Comment 'Screener'” reel drew 171 comments. Your free membership collects emails with a course, a budget planner, a wealth tracker and a Discord. These are UK investors who already use your tools and want more of you.

beats.title: Everything is self-serve. Mastery is still “coming soon”.
beats.text: Plus gives people tools and videos, but nobody gets to build their plan with you. Mastery is announced on the Plus page without details, so there's no path yet from “I use the screener” to a programme with you.

beats.title: “I'm not a financial adviser.” You don't need to be.
beats.text: The programme teaches people to make their own decisions: how ISAs and pensions work, how to build and check an ETF portfolio, how to stick to a plan. No personal recommendations, exactly the DIY approach you already teach.
beats.quote: “If you want fast wins and flashy headlines, this probably isn’t for you.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

cards.title: You know you should invest
cards.body: But ISA, SIPP, LISA, ETF, fund. You don't know where to start.

cards.title: You own a bit of everything
cards.body: Five funds that hold the same companies, and no idea if it's a plan.

cards.title: You check it every day
cards.body: Every headline makes you want to sell, buy or switch.

mechanism.title: Simple investing, done consistently.
mechanism.body: There's no secret ETF. Long-term investing is about doing the boring things well: knowing your numbers, using the right accounts, holding a portfolio you understand and sticking to it. In Mastery you build each piece with Ash, in a small group, over 12 weeks.

pillars.title: Plan
pillars.body: Your budget, emergency fund and how much you can invest each month.

pillars.title: Wrappers
pillars.body: How ISAs, pensions and LISAs work, and which order makes sense for you.

pillars.title: Portfolio
pillars.body: Choose and check ETFs, avoid overlap, keep costs low.

pillars.title: Habit
pillars.body: Automate it, review it calmly, and ignore the noise.

items.title: 12-week programme
items.body: One module a week, from your first plan to a portfolio you understand.

items.title: Live group calls
items.body: Weekly calls with Ash to ask questions and work through the module.

items.title: Plus tools included
items.body: ETF and stock screener, portfolio analysis and overlap tools.

items.title: Research checklist
items.body: Ash's checklist for researching ETFs and quality companies.

items.title: Private community
items.body: A small group of UK investors going through the same steps.

items.title: Your written plan
items.body: Finish with an investing plan you've written yourself.

proof.title: Members
proof.note: Individual experiences vary. The value of investments can go down as well as up, and you may get back less than you invest.

steps.title: Book a call
steps.body: If it looks like a fit, pick a time to talk with Ash's team.

steps.title: Decide on the call
steps.body: We look at where you are and whether it makes sense. The investment is explained on the call. No pressure either way.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a rough idea of your monthly budget and which accounts you already have (ISA, pension, etc.).

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Ash

preCallEmails.subject: Simple investing often wins
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most people don't need a clever strategy. They need a plan they understand and will stick to.

That's what Mastery is built on: your numbers, the right accounts, a simple portfolio, and the habit to keep going.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Ash

preCallEmails.subject: "I already have Plus"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Great. Then you've got the tools.

Mastery is for when tools aren't enough: 12 weeks to build your own plan step by step, with live calls and a group doing the same.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Ash

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Ash

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Ash's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Ash

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Ash
